title: Binary Tree Paths
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, return all root-to-leaf paths in any order.

A leaf is a node with no children.

Example 1:

Input: root = [1,2,3,null,5]
Output: ["1->2->5","1->3"]

Example 2:

Input: root = [1]
Output: ["1"]

Constraints:

  • The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 100].
  • -100 <= Node.val <= 100

testCases.input: root = [1, 2, 3, 4, null, 5, 6, null, 7, null, null, 8, null, null, 9]
root = [1, 2, null, 3, null, 4, null, 5, null, 6, null, 7, null, 8, null, 9, null, 10]
root = [1, null, 2, null, 3, null, 4, null, 5, null, 6, null, 7, null, 8, null, 9, null, 10]
